svg.title: Baker — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as baker, wearing an apron and a chef hat. Visible work cue: A broad scored loaf rests on a horizontal baking peel with a long downward handle. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a chef hat.
